source.covariance_implementation_distinction: Use the existing paper-text sample covariance (ddof=1), not the author's code-only 0.2 diagonal shrinkage mode.
source.libera_extension: A combination of Salcher quadratic utility with PortBench's long-only simplex, interpreted as three fictional equity-sector mandates. This is not a full replication, an estimate of actual institutions' preferences, or a private-forecast model.
source.portbench_location: Appendix C.1 T5 supplies long-only weights and sum-one constraints for a maximum-Sharpe objective. Only those feasible-set conditions are borrowed; its 4% rate, daily lookback, objective, scoring and fallback are not used.
source.salcher_locations: Section 3.2 Eq.(6), full investment quadratic utility; Tables 2-5 gamma=1,3,5; Sections 4.1 and 6 monthly FF12 excess returns 1964-2023 and rolling 60/36-month windows.
